methodology: Same unmodified upstream source and dependencies except the filesystem implementation patch. Identical benchmark sources copied into both trees. Go test binaries built with trimpath before timing. One discarded single-iteration warm-up per variant, then five 500 ms benchmark batches each, sequential in alternating order. Fixtures live on Linux temporary storage in the same Docker container. Root fixture uses identical 256-byte text; nested fixture uses plugins/example/config; unique fixture uses distinct 256-byte text. No competing test/build workloads; unrelated existing workstation services remain running. These are component benchmarks, not live HTTP latency or game/player capacity.
